review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for uses of IsCover and isCover_ lemmas. The simp set is IsCover.empty, isCover_empty_right, IsCover.refl, isCover_univ and isCover_id. Each has a clear normal form on the right-hand side: s = ∅, s ⊆ N, or s.Nonempty → N.Nonempty. I found no cycles or competing rules. IsCover.refl and isCover_id both match IsCover id s s, but both reduce it to True, so they agree. Defining IsCover as a def keeps it from being unfolded by simp, and the iUnion-ball characterisation is correctly left non-simp. The other lemmas (mono, anti, union, the alias) are conditional implications, which are poor simp lemmas. I did not run Lean. The one small uncertainty is whether a simp lemma for IsCover U s {y}, or for the empty-left case in iff form, would help downstream code. I found no use that needs one, so I am not reporting it.
